name: minisearch-wasm-build
description: Build orchestration for the minisearch-wasm npm package (not published; the publishable artifact is pkg/).

scripts.build: wasm-pack build --target web --release --no-pack --out-dir target/wasm-glue && node scripts/finalize-pkg.mjs
scripts.test:wasm: node differential/wasm_smoke.mjs && node differential/high_priority_regressions.mjs && node differential/compat_parity.mjs && node differential/api_parity.mjs && node differential/public_api.mjs && node differential/wasm_residency.mjs && node differential/core_robustness.mjs
scripts.bench:public: npm run build && node differential/gen_corpus.mjs differential/bench_corpus.json 20000 && node --expose-gc differential/bench_public.mjs
scripts.publish:pkg: npm run build && npm test && npm publish ./pkg
scripts.test:native: cargo fmt -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked && cargo test --locked --release --test snapshot_robustness
scripts.test:js: npm run test:wasm && npm run test:types && npm run test:package && npm run test:upstream && npm run check:separators && npm run check:size
scripts.test: npm run test:native && npm run test:differential && npm run test:js
